answer.reason: Hawaii's NAICS 54 (Professional, scientific, and technical services) private-sector covered employment has consistently run on the order of 38,000–45,000 jobs in recent QCEW data (roughly 7–8% of Hawaii's ~500,000+ private covered jobs), and December—the third month of Q4—would be near that level, since this sector shows little seasonal drop-off. A December 2024 figure of 39,063 covered jobs is consistent with the sector's established scale, whereas 26,691 would imply an implausibly abrupt ~one-third collapse from the sector's normal Q4 level. Based on the cited BLS QCEW Hawaii statewide 2024 Q4 dataset and prior knowledge of its sector sizes, 39,063 is the supported choice.
